scripts.build:all: npm run build:js && npm run build:lua
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build:all
scripts.rebuild:js: npm run clean:js && npm run build:js
scripts.rebuild:lua: npm run clean:lua && npm run build:lua
scripts.prepack:js: npm run rebuild:js && npm run prepare-dist
scripts.prepack:lua: npm run rebuild:lua && npm run prepare-dist
scripts.pack: npm run pack:js && npm run pack:lua
scripts.pack:js: npm run prepack:js && cd dist/js && npm pack
scripts.pack:lua: npm run prepack:lua && cd dist/lua && npm pack
scripts.publish: npm run publish:js && npm run publish:lua
scripts.publish:js: npm run prepack:js && cd dist/js && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:lua: npm run prepack:lua && cd dist/lua && npm publish --access public
